source.dataset: North Atlantic benthic d18O stack data

firewall.opening_rule: No value-bearing source file may be opened until this exact freeze and its SHA256 receipt are committed in HEAD.

mapping_depth_to_age.primary_chronology: each complete published age-model realization is applied as one indivisible depth-to-age mapping
mapping_depth_to_age.ensemble_rule: use all 1000 published realizations in file order, without synthesis, mixing, selection, repair, or outcome-dependent weighting
mapping_depth_to_age.untuned_control: apply the published untuned depth-to-age mapping to the same depth-indexed observations
mapping_depth_to_age.interpolation: linear interpolation only after a complete depth-to-age mapping has been selected, with no extrapolation beyond common support
mapping_depth_to_age.duplicate_rule: aggregate exact duplicate ages by arithmetic mean within a realization before interpolation
mapping_depth_to_age.monotonicity_rule: a non-monotone or incomplete realization is reported invalid and excluded by a source-quality rule fixed before scores are computed
mapping_depth_to_age.missing_rule: complete-case evaluation on common support, no imputation

models.X_rich: current proxy state, current astronomical forcings, fixed seasonal and latitude convention, and the same nonlinear basis and regularization budget as X_plus_H
models.X_plus_H: X_rich plus ordered lag summaries over the frozen history windows
models.matched_control: X_rich plus equal-dimensional history summaries permuted within each fixed test block
models.chronology_negative_control: repeat the full comparison under the published untuned chronology

primary_metric: out-of-block RMSE at the frozen 10 ka horizon

sesoi.age_ensemble_support_rule: the median relative gain across valid age realizations must reach 0.05 and its central 95 percent interval must be strictly positive

failure_rule: Fail if the median gain is below 0.05, its central 95 percent interval includes zero, fewer than 3 of 4 blocks pass, the matched control is not beaten at alpha 0.01, or the untuned chronology control reaches the same primary gate. Report non_testable if source integrity or common-support requirements fail.
stopping_rule: After committing this freeze, stop. Do not download, preview, parse, summarize, or analyze value-bearing files in this route.
